findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_life_quote_requirements, update_life_eapp_insured · Private data: create_life_eapp, quote_life_eapp, update_life_eapp_quote, update_life_eapp_insured · Public sink: get_life_quote_requirements, create_life_eapp, update_life_eapp_quote, update_life_eapp_insured.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_life_quote_requirements, update_life_eapp_insured · Private data: create_life_eapp, quote_life_eapp, update_life_eapp_quote, update_life_eapp_insured · Public sink: get_life_quote_requirements, create_life_eapp, update_life_eapp_quote, update_life_eapp_insured

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
